Test Steps: Verify Manager can set Goals for reportees
Test Data: 1. Log in as Manager 2. Go to Performance > Goals 3. Click 'Add Goal' 4. Fill Title, Weightage, Deadline 5. Save
Date of execution: Goal is successfully assigned to the employee and appears in their dashboard.

Test Steps: Verify validation when mandatory fields in Goal are missing
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Goal' 2. Leave 'Title' and 'Deadline' blank 3. Save
Date of execution: System blocks submission with validation errors.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Goal Deadline is set in the past
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Goal' 2. Set deadline to a past date 3. Save
Date of execution: System restricts selecting past dates for new goals.

Test Steps: Verify total Goal Weightage validation (Max 100%)
Test Data: 1. Add Goal 1 with 60% weightage 2. Add Goal 2 with 50% weightage (Total 110%)
Date of execution: System blocks the second goal showing 'Total weightage cannot exceed 100%'.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can create Self-Goals (if policy allows)
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Go to My Goals 3. Add a personal development goal 4. Submit
Date of execution: Goal is created and sent to Manager for approval.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can update progress of their active Goals
Test Data: 1. Open an Active Goal 2. Update progress slider/value from 0% to 50% 3. Save
Date of execution: Goal progress updates and is visible to Manager.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Employee enters progress > 100%
Test Data: 1. Open an Active Goal 2. Enter progress as 150% 3. Save
Date of execution: System blocks input and forces maximum limit to 100%.

Test Steps: Verify validation when attempting to edit a 'Closed' Goal
Test Data: 1. Open a Goal marked as 'Closed' or 'Completed' 2. Attempt to update progress
Date of execution: Edit/Update buttons are disabled, system prevents modification.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can initiate an Appraisal Cycle
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Go to Appraisals 3. Click 'Start Cycle' 4. Select employees and timeline
Date of execution: Cycle is created, and self-appraisal forms are dispatched to employees.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can submit Self-Appraisal rating
Test Data: 1. Open Self-Appraisal form 2. Rate goals (1-5) 3. Add comments 4. Submit
Date of execution: Form is submitted, status changes to 'Pending Manager Review'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Employee attempts to submit without mandatory comments
Test Data: 1. Give a low/high rating (e.g., 1 or 5) 2. Leave justification comments blank 3. Submit
Date of execution: System blocks submission asking for mandatory justification for extreme ratings.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can submit Review Rating for employee
Test Data: 1. Open Pending Manager Review form 2. Rate employee 3. Submit
Date of execution: Form is submitted, status changes to 'Completed' or 'Pending HR Review'.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can send Appraisal back to employee for revision
Test Data: 1. Open Appraisal form 2. Click 'Request Revision' 3. Enter reason
Date of execution: Status reverts to 'Self-Appraisal' and employee receives notification.

Test Steps: Verify automated calculation of Final Appraisal Score
Test Data: 1. Submit Self Rating (Weight 30%) 2. Submit Manager Rating (Weight 70%) 3. Check Final Score
Date of execution: System calculates weighted average score accurately.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can submit peer feedback for a colleague
Test Data: 1. Open 360-Feedback link 2. Rate colleague on teamwork/communication 3. Submit
Date of execution: Feedback is recorded securely in the database.

Test Steps: Verify anonymity in 360-Degree Feedback
Test Data: 1. Manager/Employee views the peer feedback report
Date of execution: Report shows the feedback/rating but hides the peer's name/identity.

Test Steps: Verify validation preventing Employee from submitting peer feedback for themselves
Test Data: 1. Attempt to open 360-Feedback form for own user ID
Date of execution: System blocks access or shows 'You cannot review yourself'.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can view the 9-Box Grid Report
Test Data: 1. Go to Performance Reports 2. Open 9-Box Grid
Date of execution: Employees are plotted correctly based on 'Performance' vs 'Potential' scores.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can generate Bell Curve/Normalization report
Test Data: 1. Go to Reports 2. Generate Bell Curve
Date of execution: Graph plots the distribution of employee ratings across the organization.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can only see reports for their direct reportees
Test Data: 1. Log in as Manager 2. Go to Reports
Date of execution: System restricts data strictly to the Manager's team; other teams are hidden.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can initiate Promotion based on Appraisal Score
Test Data: 1. Open highly rated employee profile 2. Click 'Initiate Promotion' 3. Change Designation
Date of execution: Promotion workflow triggers successfully.

Test Steps: Verify salary hike recommendation link to Payroll
Test Data: 1. Recommend 10% hike in Appraisal 2. Admin approves
Date of execution: Approved new salary should automatically sync with Payroll (if integrated), or generate alert.

Test Steps: Verify Employee cannot edit their Self-Appraisal after submission
Test Data: 1. Submit Self-Appraisal 2. Attempt to open and edit the form again
Date of execution: System disables editing and form is locked in Read-Only mode.

Test Steps: Verify SQL Injection in Appraisal Comments
Test Data: 1. Submit appraisal 2. Enter SQL payload in comments
Date of execution: System sanitizes the string and saves without executing queries.

Test Steps: Verify unauthorized access to another employee's appraisal
Test Data: 1. Employee A guesses URL parameter for Employee B's appraisal
Date of execution: System returns '403 Forbidden' and blocks access.
